notes: No analytics SDK, pixel, queue, dataLayer event, cookie, or external request is added by this plan. Activation requires separate owner approval and consent review.

events.name: service_inquiry_click
events.condition: A visitor follows a service-page CTA to the existing contact form

events.name: contact_phone_click
events.condition: A visitor follows a tel link
events.meaning: Phone-link intent, not a connected call

events.name: generate_lead
events.condition: The existing form receives HTTP success AND JSON ok:true from its configured backend
events.meaning: Backend-accepted inquiry, not a qualified lead or sale

attribution.term: not emitted; avoid capturing free-text search queries

activationGates: Owner approval of tools, accounts, costs, consent behavior and retention
Final conversion definition and deduplication across forms and providers
No PII in event payloads, page-location queries or URLs
Validate accepted, rejected, timeout, retry and duplicate-submit paths
Confirm analytics observations against backend receipt; a thank-you URL visit is not a conversion
